title: Taiwanese American Scholarship Fund 台美獎學金基金會
content_html: The Taiwanese American Scholarship Fund (TASF) was created in 2014 to support economically challenged students of Taiwanese descent residing in the United States in their pursuit of higher education. Through a competitive application process, scholarship funds are applied toward tuition for selected students in their first or second year of college. TASF serves as a financial resource for Taiwanese American students facing economic barriers to higher education.
